question: Which company was launched later, Fresenius Kabi (United States) or Plaza & Janés?
gold_cypher: MATCH (n:Company {name: 'Fresenius Kabi (United States)'}), (m0:Company {name: 'Plaza & Janés'}) RETURN CASE WHEN n.launch_year > m0.launch_year THEN n.name ELSE m0.name END AS answer
generated_cypher:
MATCH (c1:Company)-[:basedIn]->(country1:Country)
WHERE toLower(c1.name) CONTAINS toLower('Fresenius Kabi')
  AND toLower(country1.name) CONTAINS toLower('United States')
MATCH (c2:Company)
WHERE toLower(c2.name) CONTAINS toLower('Plaza & Janés')
WITH c1, c2,
     c1.launch_year AS ly1,
     c2.launch_year AS ly2,
     CASE WHEN c1.launch_year IS NOT NULL THEN toInteger(c1.launch_year) END AS year1,
     CASE WHEN c2.launch_year IS NOT NULL THEN toInteger(c2.launch_year) END AS year2
RETURN c1.name AS company1,
       ly1 AS launch_year1,
       c2.name AS company2,
       ly2 AS launch_year2,
       CASE
         WHEN year1 IS NULL AND year2 IS NULL THEN 'Launch years unknown for both'
         WHEN year1 IS NULL THEN c2.name
         WHEN year2 IS NULL THEN c1.name
         WHEN year1 > year2 THEN c1.name
         WHEN year2 > year1 THEN c2.name
         ELSE 'Both launched in the same year'
       END AS later_company
answer: I’m unable to determine which company was launched later because the query returned no data about the launch dates of Fresenius Kabi (United States) or Plaza & Janés.
